title: eps-eta Walden coupling pairs and the DN fifth-channel registration: the build contract
lock_rule: The pairing rule, the temperature-alignment rule, the coupling definition, the DN admissibility rule and the DN coverage threshold are frozen before the first run. A later round may add a column; it may not relax a rule, and a rule that has to change is reported as a correction rather than edited in place.
why: Appendix Z-4 called the Walden-type eps-eta coupling a free addition once the joint observation table existed (tests/fixtures/manual_appendix_j_snapshot.md, section Z-4). reports/solvating_power_descriptor_mapping.md section 2.2 rules that the Gutmann donor number is a probe-molecule property that is experimental only, and so can only ever enter as a small curated look-up table. This arm pairs the two channels of the joint table at a shared temperature, and performs the donor-number coverage check that decides whether that fifth channel may ever enter a feature table. No model is fitted.

input.role: the only input table; read only, never written by this arm
input.recount_rule: the builder recounts rows, keys and the source split itself; a recount that disagrees with the expected value above is reported as a correction, never patched in place and never silently averaged away

walden_pairs.grain: one row per (epsilon observation, viscosity observation) pair drawn from the same InChIKey whose stored T_K agree under the temperature-alignment rule
walden_pairs.t_alignment_rule: abs(T_epsilon - T_viscosity) <= t_tolerance_k; no interpolation, no extrapolation, no temperature shift, no re-rounding of the stored value
walden_pairs.t_alignment_delta_basis: the stored T_K values themselves; the joint table stores no temperature uncertainty, so the tolerance is a numeric-identity tolerance and not an uncertainty budget
walden_pairs.sensitivity_ladder_role: a reading only. It is reported as counts next to the primary reading, it never forms the pair table and it never enters a verdict. The stored temperatures sit on a coarse grid (e.g. 278.15, 280.65, 283.15 K), so a widened tolerance would merge physically distinct temperatures rather than recover a rounding artefact.

primary_coupling.name: walden_coupling_epsilon_times_eta
primary_coupling.note: epsilon is dimensionless (unit '1') and viscosity is Pa*s, so the product carries Pa*s. This is the Walden-type product analogue this arm registers; it is a derived pair statistic and never a measurement.

secondary_coupling.name: walden_ratio_eta_over_epsilon
secondary_coupling.note: reported as a second reading only; it is not the primary coupling and carries no verdict

walden_pairs.conflict_rule: when one (inchikey, T_K) cell holds m epsilon rows and n viscosity rows, all m*n combinations are emitted with both provenances; averaging_applied is false on every row and no value is ever tie-broken or dropped
walden_pairs.conflict_reading_rule: the number of overlapping cells and the number of cells with more than one value on either side are reported
walden_pairs.source_quadrant_rule: pair_source_quadrant = '{epsilon_dataset_id} x {viscosity_dataset_id}'; the four-way source split of the joint table is preserved per row so a pair is always attributable to both of its sources
walden_pairs.pair_quality_layer_rule: publishable_core only when both sides are publishable_core; otherwise filter_only. A filter_only pair may be used to filter and may never be quoted in a publishable headline; the epsilon side of this build is publishable_core throughout, so the pair layer is decided by the viscosity side
walden_pairs.row_order: sorted by (inchikey, T_K, epsilon_source_row_index, viscosity_source_row_index), so a rebuild is byte-identical
walden_pairs.no_model: no model is fitted, no R2 is produced, and the frozen baseline 0.4091179943351143 is not touched

kinematic_thaw.status_rule: the joint table already excluded the kinematic viscosity (m2/s) rows with reason kinematic_viscosity_not_dynamic; they are not observations of that table and therefore cannot enter a pair here
kinematic_thaw.thaw_dependency: data/density_v01.csv, produced by a sibling arm
kinematic_thaw.thawed_rule: thawed = data/density_v01.csv is present. While thawed is false this arm states only the family-level fact. When it becomes true a later revision may convert nu -> eta = nu * rho at a matched temperature and upgrade the reading from family level to key level, without touching this arm's committed pair table.
kinematic_thaw.family_level_only_rule: while thawed is false no key-level kinematic conclusion is stated; the arm reports the count and the dependency only

dn_channel.role: registration and coverage audit only. The channel is never fitted here and no model reads it in this arm.
dn_channel.target_key_set: the distinct InChIKeys of the joint observation table
dn_channel.secondary_target_key_set: the publishable_core and pure keys of the joint observation table
dn_channel.coverage_definition: covered_keys / target_keys, where a key counts as covered only when it carries a donor number from an admissible source
dn_channel.admissibility_rule: a donor number is admissible only when it is an experimental measurement carrying a first-hand source DOI. reports/solvating_power_descriptor_mapping.md section 2.2 rules that DN measures the chemistry of a probe molecule (SbCl5) and is experimental only, so a predicted value, a compilation-level value, or a secondary value without a readable primary is inadmissible.
dn_channel.verdict_rule: covered fraction >= coverage_threshold -> the channel is available to a later feature table; below -> the channel does not enter the feature table, and the criterion and the reading are reported. Passing the threshold is necessary, never sufficient: an inadmissible source cannot cover a key whatever the count.
dn_channel.predicted_sub_channel_rule: a predicted donor-number column, if one exists locally, is audited separately and is never merged into the admissible coverage

candidate_sources.what_the_local_text_holds: the supporting-information text names a DN-218 experimental donor-number dataset (Figure S12) and describes a model trained on it; it carries captions only and no value table
Tableau 4 prints MOPN DN = 14.6 at 25 C, transcribed from Ue 1994 (10.1149/1.2059270), whose body is blocked

candidate_sources.what_the_local_evidence_holds: the DonorNum paths are a scoring task over generated molecules (predict_dipole.out, generate-molecules outputs), not an experimental corpus; the archive carries no donor-number dataset file

artifacts.new_files_only_rule: this arm writes only the four artefacts above. data/processed/eta_epsilon_joint_observations.csv and data/processed/eta_epsilon_joint_exclusions.csv are committed products of Week 16 and are never written here.

checks: the joint table is recounted (rows, distinct keys, source split) and a disagreement is reported rather than hidden
every pair row carries both provenances and averaging_applied is false
the temperature-alignment rule holds on every pair row
the coupling columns equal the registered formulas recomputed from the two stored values
the pair quality layer equals the both-sides rule
the DN coverage fraction equals covered_keys / target_keys and the verdict follows the threshold
the six frozen artefacts keep their digests
verification_contract.manifest: a SHA256 manifest over the pairs table, the DN coverage audit, the summary and the builder script
verification_contract.verifier: scripts/verify_walden_dn_channel.py --check recomputes the pair table and the DN coverage offline from the joint table and exits 0 for PASS and 1 for FAIL

run_telemetry_contract.rule: network_calls is 0, models_fitted is 0, r2_reported is false, run_mode is offline; writes_under_data counts the two new tables this arm writes and is never zero by accident

forbidden: averaging or tie-breaking conflicting values at one (inchikey, T_K)
interpolating or extrapolating a viscosity to an epsilon temperature
quoting a filter_only pair in a publishable headline
letting an inadmissible donor-number source cover a key
fitting a model, reporting an R2, or touching the frozen baseline 0.4091179943351143
stating a key-level kinematic viscosity conclusion before data/density_v01.csv exists
